title: Rework of Kalmira's own mistake

company.company_business: IT implementation and managed services for mid-size Indian businesses

narrative_template:
On a fixed-price build for {customer}, Kalmira spent ₹6,00,000 rewriting a module its own developers built wrongly. The rework was not in the budget, and the price does not change for it. How does this cost affect the cost-to-cost measure of progress?

Round amounts to the nearest rupee and percentages to one decimal place. All names are fictional.

rubric.text: Rework is left out of the measure of progress (B19(a)).

check.correct: Leave it out of the measure of progress

options: Include it in costs to date
Leave it out of the measure of progress
explanation: Costs that do not depict progress, such as wasted effort not reflected in the price, are left out of an input method (B19(a)).

mistakes.choice: Include it in costs to date
mistakes.feedback: Rework from Kalmira's own mistake is a significant inefficiency not reflected in the price. It does not move the customer's asset forward, so it stays out of the measure of progress and is expensed as incurred (B19(a)).
